_gloamVault: Gloam's Elysium mainnet vault (Gloam, Nov 10), deployed at block 3248495, owned by their VaultOwnerGuard 0x268D7CAd645282D1e77461b5B2dd997bd54eFAf5 (controller 0x76b7...D4D8). 0.5% withdrawal fee to their treasury 0xB390...30B8. Checked on chain Nov 10.
memoBoard: FILL IN on Monday Nov 16: Cloak deploys GloamPayMemo unchanged (Gloam's CEO, Nov 12), then sends Gloam its address and deploy block so both apps share it (docs/MAINNET-DECISIONS.md H3)
factory: FILL IN: Cloak's v4 launch factory on mainnet
_withdrawFeeBps: Our vaults charge no withdrawal fee: Cloak's fee is taken in HYPE by the router and batch rounds (tradeFee below), so Cloak never holds launch or outside tokens (decided Nov 10).
_tradeFee: Cloak's fee on private sales out of its vaults (launch and ecosystem tokens into HYPE or USDC): 25 = 0.25% (decided Nov 10), taken from what the sale brings and sent to the treasury. Buys pay none here: Gloam's 0.5% applies, half of it shared with Cloak monthly. CloakTradeFee, owned by the owner wallet: lower at once, raise or move the treasury after a public 3-day wait, never above 1%.

assets._pool: USDC's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook (Nov 10 scan): 0.3% / 60, about 27,300 HYPE and 2.0M USDC in range. The router trades USDC against HYPE through it, and through HYPE against every launch and outside token (two pools, one private swap).

KNTQ's deepest native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook: 0.3% / 60. It lives in Gloam's vault (Gloam's listing, Thursday Nov 12), so the router trades it like USDC: HYPE in Gloam's vault to KNTQ in Gloam's vault, one pool; a launch token to KNTQ, two pools through HYPE.

ecosystem._note: Outside tokens (CloakEcosystemVault). Cloak vets a launchpad's code once (launchpads below: the script deploys a CloakLaunchpadCheck for each and prints the owner wallet's approveLaunchpad call). The owner wallet then lists that launchpad's tokens at once, choosing by market cap and importance; KNTQ is vetted on its own (no launchpad). Checked at every listing: a plain native-HYPE v4 pool (no hook) with at least minHypeLiquidity HYPE in range and a market cap of at least minMcapHype HYPE (both adjustable by the owner, down to the floors), and caps at most maxPerDepositBps / maxTotalBps of its supply (fixed).
ecosystem._floors: minHypeLiquidity (250 HYPE) and minMcapHype (50,000 HYPE) are starting values: the owner wallet moves them any time with setMarketRules, up without limit and down to these floors (100 HYPE in range, a 10,000 HYPE market cap), fixed at deploy. Decided Nov 10 (docs/MAINNET-DECISIONS.md, C2).
ecosystem._launchpads: Each vetted launchpad: { name, factory, selector }. factory is its contract that records the tokens it made; selector is a view f(address token) there that returns non-zero for its tokens and zero otherwise (for example isToken(address) or tokenInfo(address)). A token then names its launchpad with "launchpad": name.
ecosystem._minMcapHype: The market cap counts the token's supply on Elysium only (a bridged token's Elysium supply, not its full supply): KNTQ, with about 13.0M KNTQ on Elysium at about 186 KNTQ per HYPE, is about 69,900 HYPE (scan of Nov 10). 50,000 HYPE is about $3.7M at HYPE near $73.
ecosystem._tokens: None at launch. KNTQ lives in Gloam's vault (Gloam lists it Thursday, Nov 12, at 1,400 per deposit and 70,000 in total): one home per asset, so it's in assets above, and our ecosystem vault takes the next tokens.
